---
title: "Global"
subtitle: "Cross-country and thematic open sources"
date: today
---

::: {.lede}
The Global shelf is for sources whose value spans countries — cross-border investigative consortia,
multi-country monitoring datasets, and thematic trackers that don't belong to any single national file.
:::

This shelf is a placeholder for the pilot. Once a second and third country are in, global sources
(e.g., cross-border investigative networks, conflict-event datasets, sanctions trackers) will be
catalogued here using the same scoring rubric described in the [Methodology](../methodology.qmd).
